g.text: Database: db_zahiyyahs_fit • 8 Relational Tables with Referential Integrity (One-to-Many • Cascade/Restrict Rules)
Keterangan Integritas Referensial & Normalisasi (Slide 9 & 10 PPT UTS Web Programming 2):

• categories → products (1:N): Satu kategori memayungi banyak pakaian. • products → sale_items & purchase_items (1:N): Menggunakan SoftDeletes agar riwayat transaksi masa lalu tetap valid saat produk diarsipkan. • sales → sale_items (1:N Cascade) & purchases → purchase_items (1:N Cascade): Integritas atomik master-detail dengan Foreign Key pada tabel anak (3NF).
